messages:
taylor_ops: deploy-bot flagged the release as HOLD: env parity check failure between staging and prod. stack: inference-service. @maya_ng can you take a quick look?

deploy_bot: HOLD REASON: missing env key mapping. Detected diff: staging has `REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS=redwood-secrets`; prod has `KMS_ALIAS=redwood-secrets-prod`. Also found Helm values mismatch: `secrets.kms.alias` in staging=v2, prod=v1.

maya_ng: yup saw this in the config diff. we rolled the new env var name in the feature branch earlier but prod never got the helm value change. Prod pods will try to use legacy alias and fail to decrypt some keys.

jonathan: rough impact if we proceed without fixing?

maya_ng: startup 500s for any services that rely on the new key namespace. user-facing failures for a subset of requests that require the new embedding-key. not safe to proceed into prod.

sasha_releases: options: 1) patch prod to add `REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS=redwood-secrets` in the relevant configmap/helm values and restart; 2) pin the release to previous image tag (rollback the canary) and re-run parity job; 3) quick rollback of the staging change (not ideal).

jonathan: can we do (1) as a fast hotfix? what about audit/KMS rotation concerns?

maya_ng: (1) is fastest and low-risk: add env alias mapping so both env names exist. We should record in release notes and follow up with a proper helm values roll-forward. No KMS rotation needed.

taylor_ops: ok let's hold release. plan: patch configmap `inference-service-env` in prod to include `REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS=redwood-secrets`, then roll pods. After parity check passes, let deploy-bot retry promotion. ETA 20-30m. @jonathan can you approve the hotpatch?

jonathan: approved. :thumbsup:

sasha_releases: I'll prepare the kubectl patch and the rollout steps. snippet:```bash
kubectl -n infra patch configmap inference-service-env --patch '{"data": {"REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS": "redwood-secrets"}}'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment inference-service
```

deploy_bot: NOTE: patching configmaps will not change secrets already mounted. If a pod needs the env value at startup you must restart pods. Parity check will re-run automatically after the restart.

taylor_ops: applying patch now.

(t+6m) sasha_releases: patch applied: `kubectl patch` returned 200. starting rollout.

(t+12m) sasha_releases: rollout status: `deployment "inference-service" successfully rolled out` — all 12 pods Ready.

deploy_bot: PARITY CHECK: OK. env parity between staging and prod confirmed for `secrets.kms.alias`. Release promotion will resume.

maya_ng: I added a TODO in the release notes: "Hotpatch prod to add REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS alias to avoid decryption errors; follow up with helm values roll-forward and ensure CI parity check includes alias key."

taylor_ops: thanks everyone. reopening canary promotion. will watch logs for 15m. :eyes:

jonathan: leaving a postmortem note to track why helm values didn't carry over in the last infra bump.

sasha_releases: +1. will include the helm values diff in the follow-up ticket.
